candidates.name: SoFiUSD
candidates.scope_note: SoFi launched the product to members on 2026-05-27 and its current terms identify the on-chain token as SOFID, also called SoFiUSD. Official sources support the issuer, public-blockchain existence, Ethereum and Solana availability, 1:1 design, reserve framework, and approved-customer issuance and redemption. The reviewed public source chain does not expose the exact canonical Ethereum contract or Solana mint identities or a current indexed reserve-attestation body, so a complete deployment and assurance record is not yet supported.

identity_review.name_resolution: SoFiUSD is the product name; SOFID is the official token ticker and legal-terms identifier.

launch_review.public_use: SoFi members may buy, sell, hold, and convert; official materials state Ethereum and Solana support.

mechanism_review.reserve: High-quality liquid reserve assets intended to equal or exceed outstanding supply; current public product copy describes reserves primarily as cash.
mechanism_review.mint_redeem: Direct issuance and redemption are limited to approved SoFi customers under separate agreements; ordinary on-chain holders do not automatically receive a direct issuer redemption right.
mechanism_review.yield: No holder interest or yield by virtue of holding SOFID.

blocking_unknowns: exact canonical Ethereum contract address
exact canonical Solana mint address
current reserve-attestation index and report bodies
current reserve custodian and asset allocation by category
fees and minimums under approved-customer issuance and redemption agreements

complete_record_feasibility.reason: A launched identity and legal framework are supported, but exact deployment identity and current assurance evidence remain incomplete.

candidates.name: USA₮

candidates.scope_note: Tether announced USA₮ as launched on 2026-01-27 and Anchorage currently publishes monthly reserve attestations through June 2026. The issuer and reserve-report series are supported, but the reviewed official public source chain does not establish the complete current network set, exact canonical contract identities, holder terms, or direct mint and redemption eligibility required for a complete canonical record.

identity_review.lineage_note: USA₮ is a distinct Anchorage-issued product and is not the same asset as Tether USD₮.

launch_review.public_use: Official issuer and collaborator materials describe a launched U.S.-regulated dollar-backed stablecoin.

mechanism_review.reserve: Monthly reserve holdings disclosed through independent Big Four attestation reports.
mechanism_review.mint_redeem: Anchorage states stablecoins it issues are redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars on its platform; product-specific eligibility and holder terms were not located in the reviewed source chain.

candidates.name: Bison Bank Electronic Money Token — Euro
candidates.scope_note: Bison Bank officially launched EUB on 2026-05-06 as one of two distinct EMTs. Current primary sources support the issuer, EUR reference, 1:1 fiat backing and par redemption, institutional allowlist boundary, direct mint and redeem workflow, Solana Token-2022 deployment family, and MiCA legal context. Exact Solana mint identity and report-specific reserve evidence must be freshly resolved or retained as explicit unknowns in any implementation.

identity_review.paired_lineage: Sibling product of USB under the Bison Bank Electronic Money Token program; distinct reference asset and token identity.

launch_review.public_use: Restricted to pre-approved institutional-partner wallets and Bison Bank account holders.

mechanism_review.reserve: Fully backed by fiat reserves; Bison Bank states it is audited regularly by Deloitte and maintains liquidity for redemption obligations.
mechanism_review.mint_redeem: Institutional partners request mint and redeem through Bison Mobile; holders have a right to redemption at par subject to KYC and wallet screening.

candidates.name: Swiss joint CHF stablecoin sandbox token
candidates.issuer_or_operator: Swiss Stablecoin AG with participating Swiss banks
candidates.scope_note: UBS and the participating institutions describe a controlled live sandbox intended to test possible CHF-stablecoin use cases during 2026. The announcement explicitly states that Switzerland does not yet have a regulated CHF stablecoin with broad application and frames the sandbox as preparation for a possible later market decision. No final token name, symbol, legal issuer, public distribution, or canonical deployment identity is established.

candidates.name: Hazel Network unified token
candidates.issuer_or_operator: Vantage Bank, Custodia Bank, and future consortium member banks
candidates.scope_note: Hazel Network has a live Ethereum mainnet reference implementation and testing program, but its announced design is infrastructure for a dual-character token that changes between a consortium bank deposit and an external stablecoin. Full availability is scheduled for Q4 2026, participating issuers are not yet fully identified, and no final independently named canonical stablecoin identity, symbol, or production contract is established.

mechanism_review.inside_consortium: Tokenized bank deposit with the member bank as obligor.
mechanism_review.outside_consortium: Planned stablecoin character backed at least 1:1 by liquid assets.
mechanism_review.transition: The same token is designed to change legal and economic character at the consortium boundary without a separate conversion transaction.

blocking_unknowns: final canonical asset name and symbol
exact production contract identity
final stablecoin legal issuer or issuers
first external stablecoin issuance and circulation

complete_record_feasibility.reason: The current evidence supports infrastructure and testing, not a finalized independently identifiable production stablecoin.
